subject: Clarification: differential routing activation during API slowdown
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@maplebridge.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 11:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Latency + partial 5xx pattern on hosted inference (MapleBridge)

Marcus —

We're seeing sustained p95 elevation and a small number of partial 502/504s against your hosted API for our production workspace since ~07:30 PT. The attached csv has token-level request samples and latency buckets. The issue looks regionally focused to us (US-west) but it's impacting our real-time scoring.

Can you confirm whether any routing or model-variant changes were deployed this morning? We haven't received a status page update and are getting questions from the on-call team.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Infrastructure
MapleBridge Analytics

Subject: Re: Latency + partial 5xx pattern on hosted inference (MapleBridge)

Thanks for the heads up, Alicia — we see the same signal on our side.

Quick summary of next steps (short-term):
- I've opened an ops bridge and looped in Hannah and Marissa for immediate triage.
- We'll enable a targeted differential routing policy for Map leBridge's tenant traffic in the affected US-west pool. This will route requests to the smaller-variant model variant and to an alternate capacity pool while we investigate KV cache churn.
- I'll post a status page entry with the current mitigation and ETA within 30 minutes.

Can you attach a sample request id (x-request-id) from one of the failed requests? That will speed correlation.

Apologies for the disruption — I'll update you as soon as we flip routing and confirm reduction in 5xx.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Latency + partial 5xx pattern on hosted inference (MapleBridge)

On Fri, Nov 24, 2028 at 8:25 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads up, Alicia — we see the same signal on our side.

Bridge notes:
- Observed KV-cache eviction spike in us-west-2 between 07:20–08:40 PT correlating with a prefetch fanout increase from several tenants. Memory pressure caused transient tail latencies and amplified retry behavior for long prompt sequences.
- Action taken: activated differential routing for MapleBridge (route -> smaller-variant + alternate pool us-west-2b). Also tightened auto-batch window for their token-length distribution to reduce fanout.
- Impact: immediate reduction in p95 for sampled flows; 5xx rate down from 0.8% -> 0.12% in the first 10m.
- Next: we will keep differential routing on for 2 hours and then run a staged rollback if stable. Creating a short statuspage entry now (draft attached).

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: incident-snapshot.png
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@maplebridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 11:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Hosted API: differential routing activated for MapleBridge (update + status link)

Alicia — following up with a customer-facing note.

What we did
- At 08:45 PT we enabled a tenant-scoped differential routing policy for MapleBridge in us-west. Traffic is temporarily routed to a smaller model variant and an alternate capacity pool while we monitor cache stabilization.
- This is a non-invasive routing change (no model swap for you; same semantic model variant family) designed to reduce cold/KV pressure and lower retry amplification.

Observed impact
- Sampled p95 dropped ~45% for affected flows within 10 minutes.
- Partial 5xx rate dropped to ~0.12%; tail latency and retry counts are trending down.

What we're doing next
- Continue monitoring for 2h; if metrics remain stable we'll perform a controlled rollback and provide a rollback runbook.
- A post-incident note and internal RCA will be shared by Monday with root-cause details and long-term mitigations (prefetch tuning + token-aware batching policy changes).

Status link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2028-11-24-differential-routing
Estimated next update: 2h or earlier if conditions change.

Please reply here if you'd like a short call — otherwise I plan to send a consolidated postmortem with timelines.

Best,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
